subject.title: Feishu: benign non-zero exec exit codes render as "Exec failed" in tool-progress and interrupt streaming; no per-channel toolProgress toggle

question: Should Feishu adopt the shared nested streaming preview policy for `streaming.preview.toolProgress` and `streaming.preview.commandText`, and should `channels.feishu.streaming` remain protected from gateway `config.patch`?
rationale: The source-level Feishu gap is clear, but the fix changes public plugin config shape and possibly the model-to-operator config mutation boundary, so maintainer intent is required before implementation.

options.title: Adopt shared Feishu preview policy
options.body: Extend Feishu to accept and honor the shared nested preview config with backward-compatible defaults, and leave `config.patch` protection unchanged unless separately approved.

options.title: Only reduce progress wording
options.body: Keep Feishu streaming boolean-only and make progress text less disruptive, which is smaller but leaves no supported way to stream answers while hiding progress lines.

options.title: Allow coarse gateway toggle
options.body: Permit `config.patch` for `channels.feishu.streaming`, which helps recovery but broadens a protected config path and still lacks status-only progress control.

recommendation.title: Adopt shared Feishu preview policy
recommendation.body: Extend Feishu to accept and honor the shared nested preview config with backward-compatible defaults, and leave `config.patch` protection unchanged unless separately approved.

likelyOwner.reason: This account introduced Feishu Card Kit streaming and the current boolean config surface that the decision would extend.
